verdict.rationale: Paxos documents custodial onboarding (person/institution identity creation) and the ability to hold stablecoin balances rather than auto-converting to fiat, plus reserve/attestation transparency for USDG and one-to-one redeemability claims. However missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported geographies/jurisdictions, eligibility/gating criteria (e.g., KYC tiers, institutional vs retail limits), and any honest disclosure of where the custodial account is NOT available.
